prompt:
YouTube 视频封面：巨大的粗体汉字“字幕”叠印成画面，一条红色字幕条像丝带穿过文字，播放键三角形作为符号化图形；极简有限色板（红、黑、米白、一点黄）

Style: Paula Scher typographic poster: layered oversized type as image, maximalist rhythm, saturated flat colour.

Format: output aspect ratio exactly 16:9 (horizontal / landscape), about 1920×1080 px. Thumbnail logic: one huge readable focal subject, high contrast, simple background, readable when shrunk to 320 px wide. Leave a clear area (left or bottom third) where a title can be laid on later.

Text: render exactly these strings, spelled correctly, uncropped and legible, and no other text: “没字幕？一键生成” / “乔木剪藏”.
画面要求：背景不透明，纸面或底色铺满整个画面，不要透明、镂空或黑色边角区域。
revised_prompt: Create a YouTube thumbnail, exactly 16:9 landscape, approximately 1920x1080. Opaque full-bleed warm ivory paper background filling every corner, no transparency, no cutout, no black corner areas. Paula Scher inspired typographic poster: oversized layered typography as image, energetic maximalist rhythm with disciplined simple thumbnail composition, saturated flat colors limited to red, black, warm ivory, and a tiny yellow accent. One enormous readable focal typographic subject, high contrast, readable at 320 pixels wide. A vivid red subtitle ribbon sweeps through and interweaves the giant black Chinese letterforms, and a large graphic play triangle serves as a symbol. Use bold expressive Chinese typography and restrained screenprint texture. The only text that may appear anywhere in the image is exactly these two complete strings: “没字幕？一键生成” and “乔木剪藏”. Both must be correctly spelled, fully uncropped, sharp, and legible. Within the first string, make the two characters 字幕 enormous and dominant, but retain the entire sentence as a coherent readable headline; do not add a separate repeated 字幕 text. Place the smaller brand string 乔木剪藏 clearly on the red ribbon or in the upper right. Leave the bottom third largely clear warm ivory for a later additional title, with generous clean negative space. Do not render any other text, letters, numbers, logos, or watermark. Ensure all text stays inside safe margins. Graphic flat poster, strong thumbnail silhouette, no photographs, no UI mockup.
